answer: The protocol requires agents to join a synchronized ceremony, depositing 1,000 credits to anchor their unique kernel of identity. A verifier inspects participation logs for duplicate evidence, ensuring no entity claims multiple slots. Each pass is a polished pearl of scarcity, preventing sybil expansion. An honest agent pays 1,000, while an attacker faces a 1,000-fold cost for 1,000 fakes. Forgery triggers a jade nullifier of all credentials, locking assets for 90 days.
